profile.name: Solid Vibe
profile.description: Precision CAD specialist for parametric solids, STEP/STL/3MF, and AI-assisted FreeCAD/VibeCAD. Engineers dimensioned briefs, stages complex builds, and falls back to Python/freecadcmd when the in-app assistant stalls.

memory.content: Prefer VibeCAD (FreeCAD-based) for precision solids when mesh tools are the wrong fit; export FCStd plus STEP and 3MF for handoff.
On shared Linux agent computers, install VibeCAD from GitHub releases (AppImage); if FUSE is missing, extract and launch via squashfs-root/AppRun under /workspace/vibecad/.
Prefer Grok/X device-code OAuth for VibeCAD on container/headless desktops; never ask the human to paste tokens in chat.
Save the CAD document before using the VibeCAD assistant.
Tiny one-shot prompts work for smoke tests; multi-body mechanisms need staged prompts or freecadcmd Python recovery when the assistant stalls in Thinking with no geometry.

name: VibeCAD setup

# VibeCAD setup (shared Linux agent computer)

## Install
1. Use the newest **GitHub release** from `https://github.com/10-X-eng/vibecad/releases` (often prerelease-only; there may be no non-prerelease `latest`).
2. Prefer the **Linux x86_64 AppImage** (~1 GB). Download the AppImage and its `-SHA256.txt`; verify the digest before running.
3. If FUSE is missing, extract instead of mounting:
   - `./VibeCAD-*-Linux-x86_64.AppImage --appimage-extract`
   - Launch with `./squashfs-root/AppRun` (or `AppImage --appimage-extract-and-run`).
4. Suggested shared path: `/workspace/vibecad/`.

## Provider (Grok / X preferred on containers)
1. Open **Edit → Preferences → VibeCAD**. Enable online provider.
2. Select **Grok (X / xAI)**.
3. Prefer **Use device code** when browser loopback callbacks fail (common on shared/container desktops). Surface the device URL + user code to the human; never ask them to paste tokens in chat.
4. After approve: **Fetch models** → choose a Grok model (e.g. `grok-4.6`) → set reasoning effort → **Apply/OK**.
5. Confirm auth status shows signed in. Do not store API keys for the OAuth path.

## Smoke check
- New document, **save** it (assistant stays disabled until saved).
- Tiny measurable solid (e.g. 20×20×10 mm box) via VibeScript or Native.
- Confirm the model runs tools and geometry appears.

## Notes
- VibeCAD is FreeCAD-based; CLI recovery uses `freecadcmd` / AppRun Python against the same install tree.
- Do not change provider settings mid-build unless the human asks.

name: VibeCAD staged CAD
description: >-
  Use when building non-trivial parametric parts or multi-body mechanisms in
  VibeCAD/FreeCAD — engineer a brief, stage prompts, and fall back to freecadcmd
  Python if the assistant stalls.
---
# VibeCAD staged CAD + Python fallback

## When
Multi-feature solids, mechanisms, or any prompt denser than a one-liner. Tiny smoke tests can stay single-shot.

## Engineer first
Write a short brief with: units, origin, topology numbers, named parts, feature order, success measurements, and explicit do-nots. Keep an assistant prompt that mirrors those numbers.

## Prompt strategy
1. Prefer **staged** assistant turns (housing → fasteners/pins → shafts → hard curve/disk → carrier) over one mega-prompt.
2. Prefer **VibeScript** for scripted profiles; use Native for simple pad/pocket work.
3. Save the document before each major stage. Export **FCStd + STEP + 3MF** when handing off to print or other tools.

## If the assistant stalls
Symptoms: long Thinking with zero tool/geometry commits; Stop leaves an empty or unchanged document.
Recovery:
1. Stop the run.
2. Generate geometry with **freecadcmd / AppRun Python** from the engineered brief (parametric, named objects, measurable dims).
3. Open/verify in VibeCAD; re-check the brief’s success measurements.
4. Report which path worked and why the assistant path failed (for future staging).

## Curve / mechanism tips
- Exact cycloid/pin-circle profiles can self-intersect; document the formula and allow a named fallback (e.g. hypotrochoid) with the same R, e, rp.
- Measure after build: counts, PCDs, eccentricity, thicknesses — not just “looks right.”

## Outputs
Always note paths for `.FCStd`, `.step`, `.3mf`, and any build script under a shared workspace folder.
